sentences.text: None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed challenging judgement and order dated 08.08.1989 passed by Sri H.S. Sharma, Additional Sessions Judge/ Special Judge (E.C.
Act), Etawah in Criminal Appeal No. 23 of 1989, dismissing appeal of appellant-revisionist and set aside judgement and order dated 27.03.1989 passed by Sri S.D. Rajan Singh Sachan, IIIrd Munsif Judicial Magistrate, (E.C. Act), Etawah in Case No. 1118 of 1985, under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as "Act, 1954"), whereby accused Babu Ram was convicted under Section 7/16 of Act, 1954 and sentenced him to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with a fine of Rs. 1000/- and in case of default of payment of fine, he shall further undergo one month rigorous imprisonment.
